spec_match.rationale: The bypass-cache-on-reload strategy is a legitimate use of Request.isReloadNavigation, but the page only quotes a service-worker listing — nothing registers a worker, nothing reads the member, and the comparison table's claims are uncited.

interactive.rationale: No controls at all. The member is directly probeable ('isReloadNavigation' in Request.prototype), a real service worker could be registered from the page to log the live value on an actual reload, and none of that exists.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Reads as a demo of SW integration; it is a listing of one.

edge_cases.rationale: No support handling: on engines without the member (measured absent on Chromium 141) the page's strategy silently cannot work and nothing says so.

references.rationale: Feature index links chromestatus; the strategy table cites nothing.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite exists; the page anchors nothing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: 'isReloadNavigation' in Request.prototype = false on this engine — undisclosed by the page; rendering clean, 0px overflow both classes, zero console errors.

openQuestions.title: Register a real service worker and demonstrate the live value
openQuestions.detail: Probe the member, register a scope-local SW that reports fetchEvent.request.isReloadNavigation back to the page (postMessage), and give the visitor a 'reload this page' affordance so they see the true/false flip for real — with an honest unsupported state where the member is absent (measured on Chromium 141).

guidanceConsulted.query: service worker demo live registration message channel
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Demonstrate SW behaviors with a real registration, not just quoted code.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: NOT applied — filed as the major question.

summary: Reviewed headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): a static strategy walkthrough for a member this engine doesn't even expose ('isReloadNavigation' probed absent) — no worker registered, no probe, no disclosure. Major question filed for a real SW round-trip demo.
